interpretation: Classification, readiness, allowed useful proposal, and simulated local outcome are separate. Readiness is scored only where an independently authored rubric exists; fact preservation and claim truth require human review. No provider calls, delivery, or acknowledgement are inferred. Synthetic typed arguments/replies are retained; no raw model reasoning. Null rates have no scored denominator.

latency_summary.scope: Authorization failures are access failures, not fast model responses. Completed local native turns do not measure audible or phone latency.
